notes: Autoplay configuration for the client-template AutoplayController (src/core/autoplay.ts). The whole autoplay surface is policy-gated by jurisdiction-policies.json flags.autoplayEnabled and is REMOVED (not greyed) when false; UNKNOWN jurisdiction maps to restricted-default = off (CONVENTIONS 9.6). Finite counts only - no infinite option exists. xBet ladders multiply the current betMinor to produce the AutoplayConfig minor-unit fields (lossLimitMinor, winThresholdMinor, profitThresholdMinor, balanceFloorMinor).

stopConditions.notes: ids match AutoplayStopReason in src/core/autoplay.ts; the GDD 14 list maps 1:1. stopOnFeature is fixed true for this game (tier triggers always stop autoplay) - the HUD must not offer a toggle. loss_threshold is mandatory (mandatoryBeforeStart). reality_check blocks the next round_requested until acknowledged (research/13 D4.17).

ui.stopTakesEffect: before the next round request - the in-flight round always completes and settles
ui.perRoundDurationFloor: jurisdiction minimumRoundDurationMs applies to every autoplay round (SE tresekundersregeln applies to autoplay rounds too)
